capabilities.label: GL/chart of accounts
capabilities.detail: double-entry, chart of accounts (unlimited on Advanced), GL report, journal entries, automated bookkeeping/auto-categorization, class + location tracking, custom/enhanced custom fields (Advanced), fixed asset accounting (Advanced), multicurrency (Essentials+), audit log

capabilities.label: Invoicing/AR
capabilities.detail: invoices + estimates, customizable invoices, progress invoicing, recurring invoices (Essentials+), auto payment reminders, delayed charges, track expenses/time by customer, batch invoices (Advanced), "Invoicing on Autopilot" (AI, Advanced), pay-enabled links, estimate-to-invoice, credit memos

capabilities.label: Bill pay/AP
capabilities.detail: manage bills, bill tracking & payment scheduling, purchase orders (Plus+), vendor management, integrated Bill Pay (Elite bundled in Advanced), AP approval requests, print checks
features: integrated Bill Pay (Elite bundled in Advanced)

capabilities.label: Expense management
capabilities.detail: income/expense tracking, mobile receipt capture, auto-match receipts, categorize expenses, team expense tracking, billable expenses, tax-deduction maximization

capabilities.label: Bank reconciliation
capabilities.detail: automated bank feeds, auto-download & auto-categorize, reconciliation, bank rules, "Continuously Clean Books" (AI, Advanced), AI find-and-fix errors

capabilities.label: Reporting
capabilities.detail: modern-view reports, P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, GL; ~20 reports (Simple Start) → 115+ customizable (Advanced), custom report builder, business analytics center (Advanced), Spreadsheet Sync/Excel (Advanced), Conversational BI + AI forecasting (Advanced)

capabilities.label: Budgeting/FP&A
capabilities.detail: budgets (Plus+), budget vs actuals, AI forecasting, cash flow planner, business analytics dashboard (Advanced)

capabilities.label: Multi-entity
capabilities.detail: not native (separate companies or third-party apps; multi-location + class tracking on Plus+) — a known gap vs mid-market ERPs
features: not native (separate companies or third-party apps; multi-location + class tracking on Plus+) — a known gap vs mid-market ERPs

capabilities.label: Tax
capabilities.detail: automated sales tax (rate calc by location, collect/report/pay), sales tax tracking, 1099 contractor management + e-file, deduction tracking
features: automated sales tax (rate calc by location, collect/report/pay)

capabilities.label: Payroll (Core/Premium/Elite add-ons)
capabilities.detail: full-service auto payroll, automated federal/state tax calc/filing/payment, W-2/1099 filing, next-day (Core) / same-day (Premium/Elite) direct deposit, health benefits & workers' comp, 401(k), tax penalty protection up to $25K (Elite)

capabilities.label: Payments (QuickBooks Payments)
capabilities.detail: cards, ACH, digital wallets (Apple/Google Pay/PayPal/Venmo), contactless/NFC, mobile card reader + GoPayment, virtual terminal, payment links, recurring, next-day funding, instant deposit with QuickBooks Checking, e-commerce integrations

capabilities.label: Inventory
capabilities.detail: track inventory & COGS (Plus+), quantity/valuation, purchase orders, reorder points/low-stock, product/service catalog

capabilities.label: Projects/job costing
capabilities.detail: track project profitability (Plus+), job costing, estimated-vs-actual (Advanced), assign transactions/time/expenses to projects

capabilities.label: Time/mileage
capabilities.detail: track time & add to invoices (Essentials+), billable time, QuickBooks Time (GPS clock-in via Payroll Premium/Elite), automatic GPS mileage tracking
features: QuickBooks Time (GPS clock-in via Payroll Premium/Elite)

capabilities.label: Cash flow
capabilities.detail: cash flow management, planner/forecast, statement, business dashboard

capabilities.label: Workflow/controls (Advanced)
capabilities.detail: custom approval workflows, custom user roles, batch enter/edit, revenue recognition (Plus+/Advanced), point-in-time data restoration

capabilities.label: AI (Intuit Assist)
capabilities.detail: AI assistant, AI-drafted invoices & follow-ups, Continuously Clean Books, Conversational BI, AI error detection & forecasting

capabilities.label: Integrations
capabilities.detail: 750+ app marketplace, open API, Shopify/Amazon/eBay sync, Stripe/Square/PayPal, TurboTax

capabilities.detail: Solopreneur (~$20) · Simple Start (~$38, 1 user) · Essentials (~$75, 3 users, multicurrency/time/bills) · Plus (~$115, 5 users, inventory/projects/budgets/POs/rev rec) · Advanced (~$275, 25 users, batch/workflows/roles/analytics)
